# `csharp_style_expression_bodied_accessors`

Convert eligible block-bodied accessors. IDE0027.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `false` |  |
| `true` |  |
| `when_on_single_line` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    private int _value;

    public int Value
    {
        get { return _value; }
        set { _value = value; }
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    private int _value;

    public int Value { get { return _value; } set { _value = value; } }
}
```
:::

::::

### `csharp_style_expression_bodied_accessors = true`

```ini
csharp_style_expression_bodied_accessors = true
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    private int _value;

    public int Value { get => _value; set => _value = value; }
}
```

### `csharp_style_expression_bodied_accessors = when_on_single_line`

```ini
csharp_style_expression_bodied_accessors = when_on_single_line
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    private int _value;

    public int Value { get => _value; set => _value = value; }
}
```
